ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Enterprise-grade productivity apps helps enterprise saas product managers find the right creators, review matches, and go live with brand collaborations.

ONBOARDING
1. Define your brand goal and the audience you want to reach.
2. Review creator matches based on your product brief.
3. Approve your first creator and go live.

EMPTY STATE
1. No brand brief yet. Define your goal to see creator matches.
2. No creators matched yet. Complete your brief to see results.
3. No creators live yet. Approve a creator to get started.

ERROR
1. That did not save. Check your input and try again.
2. That step did not complete. Make sure all required fields are filled in.
3. This action failed. Reload and try again, or contact support if it continues.

TOAST
1. Saved. Your progress is recorded.
2. Done. Continue when you are ready.
3. Creator approved. You are live.

BUTTON LABELS
1. Define Brand
2. Review Matches
3. Approve Creator
4. Edit Brief
5. Save Brief
6. Compare Matches
7. View Collaborations
8. Update Brief
